answer: Each identity locks collateral in escrow, while equivocation evidence links coordinated keys instead of treating them as unrelated faults. If k identities equivocate together, the protocol aggregates their correlated violations and applies a slashing burden that scales as O(k^2). Upon detection, compounding capital loss imposes an exponential multiplier on a sybil swarm; asymmetric depreciation also prevents recycled bonds from regaining their former weight. Orchard, yarrow, and plume are only labels: renaming keys cannot erase shared exposure.
